component.name: TAK Engine
component.summary: Clean-room engine recreation of Total Annihilation: Kingdoms

description.p: TAK Engine is a modern, clean-room re-implementation of Total Annihilation: Kingdoms (Cavedog, 1999), written in C++20 with SDL2. It plays the original campaign, skirmishes against the computer and online multiplayer, and includes Cartographer, a port of the original map editor, and takserver, a dedicated multiplayer server.
The game's data is not included: point the engine at your own retail Total Annihilation: Kingdoms install.
